title: UMCD typed frozen split child artifact roster v2
description: The exact roster bytes must be detached-signature verified under the umcd-channel-child-artifact-roster-v1@github.com OpenSSH namespace. It may list multiple artifacts per child and must include a ChannelDataset NPZ for every frozen child. Every listed artifact is byte-hash verified; ChannelDataset rows are checked against child, kind, and parent bindings. Artifacts typed nr_trajectory_store_manifest_json are traversed through their stored trajectory and record hashes, and every record's split subject/child/kind provenance is checked against the frozen child binding. Artifacts typed nr_record_store_manifest_json are read through the canonical NR record-store reader and checked against the frozen child binding. Unrecognized supplemental types receive byte-integrity checks only. This does not establish complete-corpus authority or release qualification.
